name: Shave the Head
summary: With your back to the straps and tipped slightly forward, hands start behind the head with elbows wide and press up on a diagonal until the arms are straight.
steps: Sit or kneel facing the footbar, body hinged a little forward with a long spine.
Short loops in the hands, thumbs and first fingers touching behind the head, elbows wide.
Breathe out to press the hands up along the line of the spine.
Breathe in to bend, hands skimming the back of the head.

cautions.note: Loaded overhead press from behind the head.
Keep the head level; light spring.

cues:
Elbows stay wide.
Shoulders stay down as the arms go up.
The hinge doesn't change.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Hands start at the forehead (see Salute)
